Sandia Pueblo

Sandia is a distinct Tiwa Pueblo in central New Mexico. Its public accounts connect community continuity with agriculture, water and habitat work. A dated EPA restoration report provides a second perspective on one Rio Grande project.

03

Water and habitat responsibilities

Sandia’s Environment Department describes agricultural water delivery, water-quality protection, wildlife habitat and cottonwood bosque restoration. It also explains partnerships and practical challenges. These are stated responsibilities and priorities, not proof of water safety or completed ecological recovery.

Read the sources [4] Sandia Pueblo

04

A restoration project described in 2004

EPA’s October 2004 account describes Sandia Pueblo removing invasive plants, replanting native vegetation and monitoring Rio Grande habitat with partners. Read it as a dated project description. It does not establish all planned work succeeded or characterize current conditions throughout the river.

Read the sources [5] U.S. Environmental Protection Agency
